column1: # What the builder agent type carries from the global CLAUDE.md (claude-config#3389).
# Read by render-builder-type.py, whose header says how. Tab separated:
#   drop <section> <the item's opening words> <reason>    (one item of a carried section left out)
#   keep <section> <the item's opening words> <reason>    (one item of a left out section carried)
# The test for leaving anything out: it is about talking with Dan live, about a tool this type
# does not have, or about what the orchestrating session does once a builder has handed back.
# Everything a builder writes, runs, commits or reports by is carried, and so is anything in doubt.
